abilities.name: Amplify Magic
abilities.desc: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 113 and healing spells by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Arcane Blast
abilities.desc: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 218 to 254 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 15% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec from time of initial application.

abilities.name: Arcane Brilliance
abilities.desc: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.desc: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 238 to 258 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
abilities.desc: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.desc: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 209 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Arcane Power
abilities.desc: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

abilities.name: Arcane Wrath
abilities.desc: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 406 to 496 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

abilities.name: Conjure Food
abilities.desc:
Conjures 10 cinnamon rolls, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Agate
abilities.desc:
Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 375 to 425 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
abilities.desc:
Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 775 to 925 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Jade
abilities.desc:
Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 550 to 650 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
abilities.desc:
Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1,000 to 1,200 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Water
abilities.desc:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.desc: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Dampen Magic
abilities.desc: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 135 and healing spells by up to 270. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.desc: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1,500%. Lasts 8 sec.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.desc: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.desc: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.desc: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

abilities.name: Portal: Darnassus
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Darnassus.

abilities.name: Portal: Ironforge
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

abilities.name: Portal: Orgrimmar
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Orgrimmar.

abilities.name: Portal: Stormwind
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Stormwind.

abilities.name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

abilities.name: Portal: Undercity
abilities.desc: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Undercity.

abilities.name: Presence of Mind
abilities.desc: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Remove Lesser Curse
abilities.desc: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Slow Fall
abilities.desc: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Teleport: Dalaran
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Dalaran.

abilities.name: Teleport: Darnassus
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Darnassus.

abilities.name: Teleport: Ironforge
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Ironforge.

abilities.name: Teleport: Orgrimmar
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Orgrimmar.

abilities.name: Teleport: Stormwind
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Stormwind.

abilities.name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Thunder Bluff.

abilities.name: Teleport: Undercity
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to Undercity.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.desc: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 453 to 533 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.desc: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.desc: Blasts the enemy for 417 to 489 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.desc: Absorbs 913 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.desc: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 425 to 541 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.desc: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 381 to 465 Fire damage and an additional 332 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.

abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.desc: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 270 to 314 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 57 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.desc: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 520 to 646 Fire damage and an additional 212 Fire damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.desc: Scorch the enemy for 166 to 196 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.desc: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1,168 Frost damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.desc: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 260 to 286 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.desc: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.desc: Quickly launch a weak blast of frost at the enemy, causing 80 to 88 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.desc: Blasts enemies near the caster for 71 to 79 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.desc: Absorbs 913 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.desc: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 457 to 493 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

abilities.name: Ice Armor
abilities.desc: Increases Armor by 560 and frost resistance by 15. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Ice Barrier
abilities.desc: Shield yourself, absorbing 819 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 3% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 3% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.desc: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.desc: Deals 136 to 160 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 200% increased damage to Frozen targets.

abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.desc: Attack with an equipped wand.

abilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
abilities.desc: Decipher an untranslated scroll.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.desc: Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
